critical_code_review_comments: send_email_smtp's footer-suppression check is `"unsubscribe" in body_html.lower() AND unsubscribe_url in body_html` — both conditions must hold. If a user inserts an Unsubscribe link but the editor link text is e.g. 'click here' (no 'unsubscribe' substring), the per-recipient URL would still be present yet the default footer would be appended → duplicate links. Consider relaxing to URL-only check.

is_email_suppressed: when suppression_list_ids is empty AND legacy register has no hit, the function returns False. That is intentional per the new spec, but a hand-attached Global DNE is now invisible to a campaign that forgot to tick it. The dne-no-selection-warning UI is the only safety net; recommend a confirm-on-save modal when 0 DNE lists are selected to harden against accidental sends.
POST /api/lists/{id}/records returns 200 (with `record`) instead of HTTP 201; not a defect, but the iteration brief asked for 201. Tests accept either.

DELETE /api/lists/{id}/records uses request body via DeleteListRecordRequest. FastAPI/Starlette + some clients/middlewares strip bodies on DELETE; works on requests/Playwright fetch but may break for stricter ingress. Consider switching to /lists/{id}/records?email=... query.
server.py grew further to ~6431 lines. Re-flagging the request to split routers (campaigns, drips, accounts, lists, unsubscribe).

/api/unsubscribe is unauthenticated by design, but it accepts arbitrary user_id and writes to db.suppression_list / db.dne_emails / db.drip_contacts for that user_id. Anyone who can guess a user_id+email can mark it unsubscribed. Consider signed token in URL.
